payload_symbol: B = exact prepared target payload byte length; known old-context mgnp fit-select B=11421127399, not a promised new-source/selected size.

existing_primitives.reason: _complete hashes children once; object_reference hashes them again.
One full byte fingerprint per leaf; not a cheap stat check.

statusquo_late_target_path.excludes: Original builder/other memory serialization, pilot-inventory/source/numeric guard I/O and later CPU admission intake.

chosen_CPU_producer.additional_semantic_work: Original build plus unchanged _validate_inventory reconstruction/canonical hashes on CPU. Emitted hash/count is compared to final reference so a re-signed file cannot be adopted after semantic validation. Any additional postcheck or helper call increases the measured total.

chosen_receiver.operation: Exact child/type/size, lexical policy, root-pinned small marker/descriptor buffers; no object_reference/read_object composition for the large target.
Read entire target payload into immutable byte buffer, SHA that buffer once, strict-parse exactly that same buffer.
Check exact input/summary/source/part bindings, freeze one target graph, release ordinary temporaries normally; no production full-target rebuild or canonical reserialization.
Mint phase-only _FileWitness over resolved target+descriptor; match hashes/stats to authenticated entry bytes and entry namespace seal.
AFTER union measurement and before_publication: namespace+full phase-witness comparison against entry, then fresh live/deadline and cheap unchanged identity seal.
Use authenticated entry refs; no target object_reference, late target publication or full target readback; old bounded pilot-receipt writer remains.

measurement_rules: These are planned counts to prove with instrumented small fixtures and actual CPU receiver traces, not observed runtime measurements.

Count separate logical file reads, bytes requested, hashing bytes, parse/decode/freeze passes, canonical encodings and actual filesystem/disk I/O. Cache hits do not turn logical byte verification into zero cost.
Verify optimized reader equivalence to original completion/child-set/nonfinite contract; do not relax an existing numeric witness or replace bytes with cached stat.
If implementation retains object_reference/read_object or adds a target dependency to any repeated guard, update the table with the actual larger counts before feasibility/admission.
All original pilot-inventory, source, numeric witness and ledger reads remain and must be costed separately. Later independent CPU intake reconstruction also stays.
